data.name: Arqamun
data.gender_notes: Arqamun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is shaken by the thunder or shakes the earth with his power. The name Arqamun carries the meaning “Thunder” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Arqamun usually hope their child will grow to embody thunder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sign of Allah's power and wrath
data.etymology: Arqamun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Thunder.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arqamun total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: أرقم
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم يعني الشخص الذي يتميز بالكتابة والقراءة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أرقم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ر-ق-م' والذي يعني الكتابة أو الترقيم. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يتميز بالكتابة والقراءة، أو الذي يمتلك مهارة عالية في هذه المجالات. ويرتبط هذا الاسم أيضًا بالعديد من المفاهيم الروحية في الإسلام، حيث يعتبر الكتابة والقراءة من أهم الوسائل لنشر العلم والمعرفة.

in_urdu.name: ارقم
in_urdu.meaning: یہ نام لکھنے اور پڑھنے میں مہارت رکھنے والے شخص کے لئے ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ارقم نام عربی جڑ 'ر-ق-م' سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے لکھنا یا تعداد کرنا۔ اردو میں، یہ نام ان شخصیتوں کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو لکھنے اور پڑھنے میں مہارت رکھتے ہیں، یا جن کے پاس ان فنوں میں اعلیٰ درجات ہیں۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، لکھنا اور پڑھنا علم اور معرفت کے پھیلاؤ کے لئے اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے، جس سے یہ نام خاص روحانی اہمیت کا حامل ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अरकम
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम लिखने और पढ़ने में प्रवीण व्यक्ति के लिए है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अरकम नाम अरबी मूल 'र-ق-م' से आया है, जिसका अर्थ है लिखना या अंकन करना। हिंदी में, यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो लिखने और पढ़ने में कुशल होते हैं या जिनके पास इन कलाओं में उच्च स्तर की महारत होती है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, लेखन और पठन को ज्ञान और समझ के प्रसार के महत्वपूर्ण साधन माना जाता है, जिससे यह नाम विशेष आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: ارقم
in_pashto.meaning: دا نوم د ليکلو او لوستلو په مهارت لرونکي سړي لپاره کارول کېږي
in_pashto.long_meaning: ارقم نوم د عربي ريښې 'ر-ق-م' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د ليکلو يا شمېرنې معنی لري. په پښتو کې، دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کېږي چې په ليکلو او لوستلو کې مهارت لري، يا کوم چې په دې هنرونو کې لوړه کچه لري. په اسلامي دود کې، ليکلو او لوستل د پوهې او پوهنې د خپرولو لپاره مهم ګڼل کېږي، چې له دې امله دا نوم ځانګړی روحاني اهميت لري.

in_english.name: Arqamun
in_english.meaning: The name signifies a person skilled in writing and reading
in_english.long_meaning: The name Arqamun is derived from the Arabic root 'ر-ق-م' (r-q-m), which means to write or to count. In Islamic tradition, writing and reading are considered vital means of disseminating knowledge and understanding. This name is often associated with individuals who possess a high degree of skill in these areas. Etymologically, the term is linked to several Quranic concepts related to recording and counting, emphasizing the importance of literacy and intellectual pursuits in Islam.

data.cultural_impact: The name Arqamun holds a significant cultural impact in Islamic history as it is believed to be the name of one of the companions of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). Arqam ibn Arprees Al-Muzani was a young man from the tribe of Aus who embraced Islam at an early age. He played a crucial role in the early Islamic community in Madinah, contributing to the defense and growth of the Muslim state. Arqam's bravery and dedication to the cause of Islam have been recorded in several hadiths and historical accounts.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Arqamun carries a deep spiritual significance as it reflects the power and might of Allah. The name hints at the awesome power of Allah's creation, represented by the natural phenomenon of thunder. At the same time, it highlights the importance of submission and humility before Allah. As a companion of the Prophet (PBUH), Arqam's life embodies the spiritual values of faith, courage, and service to the Muslim community. The name Arqamun serves as a reminder of one's dependence on Allah's power and the need to strive in His path with unwavering faith and determination.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Thunder" symbolizes The one who is shaken by the thunder or shakes the earth with his power. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Arqamun serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of thunder.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Arqam ibn Abi'l-Arqam was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Arqamun carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Arqam ibn Abi'l-Arqam was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad during the early years of Islam. He is mentioned in several Hadiths and Sunnahs.
